We need answer Chinese economics multiple choice. User asks final line format "答案：[LETTER]". Need solve. Question: 无差异曲线上任一点斜率的绝对值代表了____ Options:
A. 消费者为了提高效用而获得另一些商品时愿意放弃的某一种商品的数量
B. 消费者花在各种商品上的货币总值
C. 两种商品的价格的价格比率
D. 在确保消费者效用不变的情况下，一种商品和另一种商品的交换比率

Need identify correct. Indifference curve slope absolute value is MRS (marginal rate of substitution), amount of good Y consumer willing to give up to get one more unit of good X while maintaining same utility. It is an exchange ratio keeping utility constant. Option D says under ensuring consumer utility unchanged, exchange ratio of one good and another. That's MRS. A says to improve utility? "为了提高效用而获得另一些商品时愿意放弃的某一种商品的数量" that's not exactly; MRS is along indifference curve (same utility). Sometimes MRS is max amount of Y willing to give up to get one more X while remaining at least same satisfaction? It is willing to give up while keeping utility same. D best. C is price ratio at optimal. B irrelevant. Need final answer D with brief? User requires last line exactly. Can include explanation? Probably okay. Need ensure last line format.
content:
无差异曲线上任一点斜率的绝对值代表边际替代率（MRS），即在保持效用不变的情况下，一种商品和另一种商品之间的交换比率。

答案：D
